newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World Infra in Tianjin road project - paper.
newsitem.headline: New World Infra in Tianjin road project - paper.

text.p: New World Infrastructure Ltd (NWI) will sign letters of intent involving total investments of 20 billion yuan with the northeastern Chinese city of Tianjin to develop three highways and a road, the Beijing-backed Ta Kung Pao newspaper said on Wednesday.

NWI would take over a 51 percent stake in each of the roads with a total length of 220 km and agreements would be signed within three months, it quoted Yan Zheng, deputy director of Tianjin's foreign investment service centre, as saying.
The cooperation was long-term and the contracted period would be about 25 years, he added.

Wang Dehui, a vice mayor of Tianjin, also said New World China Ltd, a unit of New World Development Co Ltd, would sign a letter of intent for the redevelopment of an old district with investment of around 800-900 million yuan, the newspaper said.
The newspaper provided no more details. NWI and New World China were not immediately available for comment. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
